svg.text: Fourteen pipelines. Each has its own scheduler queue; integer queues are paired so an idle queue issues from its partner.
paired queues (A issues from B when A has nothing ready)
four queues of 12, or one shared queue of 48 (disputed)
4 load/store units: 3 loads + 2 stores per cycle (confirmed)
dependents issue behind a load speculatively
shadow window reissues on load replay
fill forwarding wakes a missed load
one possibly-mispredicting op issues per cycle
unit 5 divider is a side pipe, other work on unit 5 continues
int execution clocks gate when idle (HID tunables)
AMX ops leave through the load/store pipes, 2 per cycle
